scope: Exposed-development acquisition and annotation-effect experiments; no independent human annotation or public runtime qualification.

acquisition.reviewer: Root Codex assistant under ADR 0041; not independent human labels

acquisition_registration.hypothesis: Test acquisition by out-of-project student necessity uncertainty against random control while explicitly reviewing all eight nonexclusive purposes. Earlier feature-distance acquisition did not enrich mandatory edits.
acquisition_registration.source_groups: All 13 exposed original development projects; each tested project excluded from its scoring head training and calibration.
acquisition_registration.selection: Sorted source groups. Draw up to two random controls without replacement per group with seed plus group index; from the remainder draw up to two units with smallest absolute pooled eligible-token global-necessity logit, breaking ties by original unit identity.
acquisition_registration.known_shortfall_group: etcd has only one eligible previously unreviewed source unit; record its three-case shortfall rather than copying rows or dropping a group.
acquisition_registration.scoring: Use frozen partial_masks heads, including heads with unavailable delivery cutoffs, only as acquisition rankings. No probabilities, new head fit, encoder pass, threshold change, or reference-event input.
acquisition_registration.review_input: Complete original target, neighboring original units, and access to the full frozen original document. Exclude scores, selection arm, model explanation, original judgments, and reference-event metadata from the packet.
acquisition_registration.reviewer: Root Codex assistant under ADR 0041; no independent human claim.
acquisition_registration.annotation: Explicit own-reason decisions for global necessity and all eight purposes; necessary edits localized in original UTF-8 bytes with nonexclusive purposes. Optional or unknown answers stay masked. Missing purposes fail the completed-review check. No automatic unmarked-token negatives or clean-after labels.
primary_readout: counts of necessary/retain/optional/unknown by arm and group
class-support preview under the unchanged project folds
acquisition_registration.failure_policy: One bounded preparation; preserve any failure. No selection rerun or post-result reallocation. Finish all selected source reviews before comparing arms.

learning_registration.hypothesis: With unchanged features, architecture, optimizer, initialization, folds, calibration rule, and delivery, test the effect of adding 49 audited source-only complete-purpose reviews to the 256-case masked baseline.
learning_registration.model: Frozen ModernBERT cached complete target/context features; token MLP 1536 to 64 GELU to 9 logits
learning_registration.intent_loss_reduction: Mean across explicitly observed dimensions only; empty mask skips the intent loss; no default negative dimensions
learning_registration.delivery_score: Minimum of pooled unit-global necessity logit and selected token intent logit; same cutoff for both scores; calibration uses the identical unit-envelope score
learning_registration.calibration: Exclude the test source group; both known global necessity classes, at least ten selected known cases and 85 percent proxy precision; maximize true positives, then minimize false positives, then higher cutoff
learning_registration.delivery: At most two available purposes per unit, at most eight contiguous original-byte runs per purpose, protected ranges excluded; the pooled unit-global necessity score gates every token intent span; no rewrite or probability
learning_registration.inference_input: Complete raw source target and adjacent original units already bound to cached features; no reason, annotation identity, label, or evaluation judgment
learning_registration.failure_policy: One bounded offline run, no automatic retry; retain errors and every original event. New predictions do not modify the old experiment or evaluation labels.
limitations: The acquisition pool and every evaluated document are exposed development, not untouched confirmation.
Acquisition is not nested validation: query heads for other projects may have seen old labels from this tested project. Direct training and calibration still exclude the tested project.
The new reviews change both training and calibration labels and class support. Their individual effects are not separated.
Acquisition selection arms are combined; this run does not estimate separate random-versus-uncertainty training effects.
Global necessity calibration is a unit-level proxy, not a per-purpose correctness or usefulness guarantee.
Structural witnesses, class support, and available cutoffs are not semantic FULL or editorial usefulness.
Root assistant reviews under ADR 0041 are not independent human labels.
learning_registration.control_expectation: All 13 historical_masks saved heads must reproduce the prior partial_masks weight hashes exactly; mismatch fails the bounded run without retries.
primary_readout: All original unit availability and every original event target-byte union by arm and cohort
Per-project calibration grids and proposed-stream counts

learning_result.limits: This is an exposed-development annotation-effect experiment. Acquisition is not nested validation: ranking heads for other projects may have seen old labels from this tested project. Structural byte coverage and intent agreement are not semantic FULL or actual criticism usefulness. No runtime or gate change.
